articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 阿西莫格鲁认为左翼自由主义因自身误用建制权力而衰落，需以有意义的自由为基石重建共识。
paragraphs: 在与考恩的对谈中，阿西莫格鲁新书《自由民主怎么了》将矛头指向精英阶层，称左翼自由主义长期掌权却未能善用权力，导致内部虚弱，如罗马因内患而衰，难御外敌。
他否认存在客观外在标准，主张以个体有意义的自由为唯一出发点，再经社会共识构建制度。面对价值冲突，他不诉诸功利或成本收益，而强调非支配原则，需社区层面保障弱者免受强者控制。
这种立场使他既反对纯粹不干预，又拒绝国家至上，暗合他对自动化与AI的警惕——唯有赋予劳动者真正自主权，技术才可能普惠，而非加剧既有等级。

en.thesis: Acemoglu argues that left-liberalism declined because it misused institutional power, and rebuilds consensus on the foundation of meaningful freedom.
paragraphs: In a conversation with Cowen, Acemoglu, author of the new book *What's Wrong with Liberal Democracy*, points a finger at the elites, saying that left-liberalism, despite holding power for a long time, failed to use it wisely, leaving itself internally weak—like Rome that fell from internal decay and could not resist external enemies.

He denies the existence of an objective external standard, advocating that the only starting point should be the meaningful freedom of the individual, and then institutions are built through social consensus. When faced with value conflicts, he does not resort to utilitarianism or cost-benefit analysis, but emphasizes the principle of non-domination, which requires protection for the weak from the control of the strong at the community level.

This stance makes him oppose pure non-intervention and reject state supremacy alike, which aligns with his wariness of automation and AI—only by granting workers genuine autonomy can technology benefit all, rather than exacerbate existing hierarchies.

zh.thesis: DRAM地址加扰可被逆向并重组物理内存映射，进而读取CPU隔离的固件区域，使SMM、PSP等安全机制形同虚设。
paragraphs: 研究者展示攻击工具：通过逆向AMD内存控制器的地址变换，能将任意虚拟地址映射到任何物理DRAM位置，包括对内核隐藏的保护区。
在AMD Family 16h上实测成功，读取并反汇编了PSP固件中的RSA例程和SMM入口代码，表明硬件级别的隔离可被打破。
该方法依赖已公开的数据手册和物理访问，不同CPU代际略有差异，但基本思路通用，威胁所有依赖DRAM隔离的安全功能。

en.thesis: DRAM address scrambling can be reverse-engineered to remap physical memory, exposing CPU-isolated firmware regions and rendering security mechanisms like SMM and PSP ineffective.
paragraphs: The researchers demonstrated an attack tool that, by reversing the address translation logic of AMD's memory controller, can map any virtual address to any physical DRAM location, including protected regions hidden from the kernel.
In practice, they achieved success on AMD Family 16h, reading and disassembling RSA routines in the PSP firmware and SMM entry code, showing that hardware-level isolation can be broken.

The method relies on publicly available datasheets and physical access, with slight variations across CPU generations, but the underlying approach is general and threatens all security features that depend on DRAM isolation.

articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 夜间咖啡因的替代品中，paraxanthine 最安全有效，但效果因人而异，且多数选项存在风险或不确定性。
paragraphs: 咖啡因的代谢依赖肝脏酶 CYP1A2，先转为同效的 paraxanthine，再失活，有效半衰期约十小时。想缩短它，可调整酶、代谢物或起始物。
rutaecarpine 能诱导 CYP1A2 加速代谢，但可能伤肝，且作用持续两天。paraxanthine 直接服用半衰期三小时，但约三分之一的人无效。
methylliberine 半衰期仅 1.5 小时，但效果百人百样，且可能抑制 CYP1A2 反而延长咖啡因作用。综合看，paraxanthine 安全性最好，可试 50-200 毫克。

en.thesis: Among alternatives to nighttime caffeine, paraxanthine is the safest and most effective, but its effects vary by person, and most options carry risks or uncertainty.
paragraphs: Caffeine is broken down in the body by a liver enzyme called CYP1A2, which first converts it into paraxanthine—a compound with similar stimulant properties—before it is eventually inactivated. Its effective half-life is about ten hours, so to shorten that, you would need to tweak the enzyme, the metabolite, or the starting compound.

One approach, using rutaecarpine, can stimulate CYP1A2 and speed up caffeine metabolism, but it may harm the liver and its effects last for two days. Taking paraxanthine directly gives a half-life of only three hours, yet about a third of people do not respond to it. Methylliberine has a half-life of just 1.5 hours, but its effects vary widely from person to person, and it might actually inhibit CYP1A2, thereby prolonging caffeine's action. Overall, paraxanthine appears to be the safest bet, with a suggested dose of 50 to 200 milligrams.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 「全民医保」的口号应更贴近现有美国联邦医保（Medicare）的实际设计，而非照搬加拿大模式。
paragraphs: 文章指出，口号受欢迎是因为「Medicare」本身已深入人心，且公众在医疗原则上与进步派一致：不该由市场或支付能力决定治病与否。
但原则不等于政策，现实中无法无限提供免费医疗。作者认为左翼提议更像加拿大模式，而更明智的做法是让「全民医保」更接近现行美国联邦医保的实际运作。

en.thesis: The slogan 'Medicare for All' should align more closely with the actual design of the existing US federal Medicare program, rather than copying the Canadian model.
paragraphs: The article points out that the slogan is popular because 'Medicare' itself is already well-regarded, and the public agrees with progressives on the principle that healthcare should not be determined by the market or one's ability to pay.

However, principles are not the same as policy, and in reality, unlimited free healthcare cannot be provided. The author argues that left-wing proposals resemble the Canadian model more, and a wiser approach would be to make 'Medicare for All' more akin to how the current US federal Medicare actually operates.

zh.thesis: 《独自打保龄》的核心论断至今成立，但作者并未重视电视这一主因，而当下流媒体时代更印证了其隐忧。
paragraphs: 作者重读此书后发现，关于教堂衰落和互联网无法替代面对面互动的预言已被证实。但合著者指出其因果链模糊，且这种对个人主义的批判可能助长当代反动思潮。
书中仅少量篇幅谈电视，却归因于它造成一半的社会资本流失。如今流媒体加剧了此趋势，但作者未提出对策，而内容本身可能比社交减少更有害。

en.thesis: The central claim of 'Bowling Alone' still holds, but the author underweighted television as a primary cause, and the streaming era has only sharpened its warnings.
paragraphs: Rereading the book recently, the author finds its predictions about the decline of church attendance and the inability of the internet to substitute for face-to-face interaction have come true. Yet the co-author points out that its causal chain is murky, and that this critique of individualism may inadvertently fuel contemporary reactionary currents.

The book devotes only a few pages to television, blaming it for half of the loss in social capital. Today, streaming services have intensified that trend, but the author offers no remedy, and the content itself may be more harmful than the reduction in socializing.

zh.thesis: 对AI末日论者而言，不买看跌期权暴露了其真实信念——他们其实相信AI不会毁灭世界。
paragraphs: 考恩质疑那些高喊AI灭绝风险的人：既然担心，为何不花几千美元买深度虚值看跌期权对冲？这类期权在灾难真正到来前往往已有中间高点可获利离场。
他指出，市场虽难定价长期特殊风险，但正因此更应买保险。多数悲观者的投资组合仍以做多为主，说明他们内心深处并不相信末日。这与尼德霍夫反对净做空的观点呼应。

en.thesis: For AI doomsayers, not buying put options reveals their true belief—they don't actually think AI will destroy the world.
paragraphs: Cowen challenges those who loudly warn of AI extinction risk: if you're really worried, why not spend a few thousand dollars on deep out-of-the-money put options as a hedge? Such options often have an intermediate peak where you can take profits well before any catastrophe actually arrives.

He points out that while markets struggle to price long-term idiosyncratic risks, that's precisely why you should buy insurance. The fact that most pessimists' portfolios remain heavily long suggests they don't truly believe in doomsday. This echoes Niederhoffer's argument against net short positions.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: NotebookLM 从「读资料回答问题」转向「直接产出成品」，但作者对其中学生向功能仍感失望。
paragraphs: Google 推荐七个 NotebookLM 提示词，作者逐一测试后发现，新版本最核心的变化是能直接生成最终产品，而非仅辅助分析。比如一句「按难度递增出五套测验」即可完成以往多步操作。
它还能执行代码、联网搜索并生成图表或表格，例如根据收据自动建费用表，或分析房产市场并建模。但这些新能力让工具偏离了原本注重引用来源的学生体验，作者认为学生向更新反而令人失望。

en.thesis: NotebookLM has shifted from answering questions about sources to directly producing finished outputs, but the author remains disappointed with its student-oriented features.
paragraphs: Google recommended seven NotebookLM prompts, and the author tested each one, discovering that the most significant change in the new version is its ability to generate final products directly, rather than merely assisting with analysis. For instance, a single prompt like 'create five quizzes of increasing difficulty' accomplishes what previously required multiple steps.

It can also execute code, search the web, and produce charts or tables—for example, automatically building an expense table from receipts or analyzing the real estate market with modeling. However, these new capabilities pull the tool away from the source-citing student experience that originally defined it, and the author finds the student-focused updates disappointing.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 删除日历链接，主动恢复约见中的摩擦，能筛选出真正值得的会面，夺回对时间的主动权。
paragraphs: 作者曾视日历链接为效率利器，免去来回协调，但发现它将时间变成自助购物，他人可任意占用，自己却失去判断。
多数会议本就无意义，闲聊、铺垫与收尾耗去大半，且低价值者越爱开会。链接让时间商品化，故删除并回归双向确认。
此选择以效率换质量，通过增加门槛过滤无关请求，使日历成为承诺的记录而非开放市场。

en.thesis: Deleting my scheduling link and deliberately reintroducing friction into meeting requests helps filter out only the meetings that truly matter, reclaiming control over my time.
paragraphs: The author once viewed the scheduling link as a productivity tool that eliminated the back-and-forth of coordination, but soon realized it turned her time into a self-service shopping experience, where others could claim slots at will while she lost the ability to exercise her own judgment.

Most meetings are pointless to begin with, with idle chatter, warm-ups, and wrap-ups consuming the majority of the time, and ironically, those who contribute least value are the ones who most love to convene. The link commodified her time, so she deleted it and returned to a two-way confirmation process.
This choice trades efficiency for quality, using the added friction to filter out irrelevant requests, transforming the calendar from an open marketplace into a record of commitments.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
articles.author: Markoff

zh.thesis: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家人民币清算行，标志着人民币国际化在欧洲迈出关键一步。
paragraphs: 据标题，该行获批担任欧洲首个离岸人民币清算行，使得人民币在欧洲的清算和交易更加便捷。
此举将提升人民币在欧洲的使用率，但具体业务量和影响尚未披露，实际意义有待观察。

en.thesis: Deutsche Bank has been approved as Europe's first offshore yuan clearing bank, marking a key step for the internationalization of the Chinese currency in the region.
paragraphs: According to the headline, the bank has received approval to act as the first offshore yuan clearing bank in Europe, which will make clearing and trading of the yuan in Europe more convenient.
This move is expected to increase the usage of the yuan in Europe, but specific transaction volumes and impacts have not been disclosed, so its actual significance remains to be seen.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约市长曼达尼的高价二套房空置税被法院叫停，但其建房计划的方向仍不明确。
paragraphs: 史坦顿岛法官奥齐暂停了「 pied-à-terre 税」的实施，这是对市长住房计划的一个打击。此前文章提到纽约正在建设，但具体位置和成效存疑。
该税针对高价二套房，本可为可负担住房筹资。然而法院叫停凸显了政策执行的政治和法律阻力。更多细节需订阅才能得知。

en.thesis: A judge in Staten Island has blocked the city's proposed pied-à-terre tax, dealing a blow to the mayor's housing plans, while the overall direction of construction remains unclear.
paragraphs: The Staten Island judge, Judge Ozzie, has temporarily halted the implementation of the 'pied-à-terre tax,' a setback for the mayor's housing agenda. Previous reports suggested that New York is building, but the specific locations and effectiveness of these efforts are still in question.

This tax targeted high-priced second homes and was intended to raise funds for affordable housing. However, the court's intervention underscores the political and legal hurdles in implementing such policies. More details await those with a subscription.

zh.thesis: DeepSeek Harness 以插件化架构和全轨迹记录为核心，试图定义下一代智能体运行框架。
paragraphs: 这是一则开发者预览发布公告，而非分析文章，因此得分受限。它宣称所有能力——模型、工具、技能、会话等——均以插件形式存在，可在配置中替换或扩展，无需改动源码。
核心设计是「一切皆插件」和「每次运行可追踪」，通过 Cordis 内核管理插件生命周期，并记录系统提示、推理、工具调用等完整会话日志，支持回放和分支。
提供了标准、代码、最小和创作者四种运行模式，适应不同场景。但作为公告，它缺乏论证或批判性观点，只是功能罗列，对一般读者的知识增益有限。

en.thesis: DeepSeek Harness aims to define the next-generation agent runtime framework through a plugin-based architecture and full trace logging.
paragraphs: This is a developer preview announcement, not an analytical article, so its scoring is limited. It claims that all capabilities — models, tools, skills, sessions, and so on — exist as plugins that can be swapped or extended in the configuration without modifying the source code.

The core design is 'everything is a plugin' and 'every run is traceable'. The Cordis kernel manages plugin lifecycles and records complete session logs, including system prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and more, supporting replay and branching.

Four run modes are provided: standard, code, minimal, and creator, to suit different scenarios. But as an announcement, it lacks argumentation or critical perspective, merely listing features, so the gain in knowledge for a general reader is limited.

zh.thesis: 标题仅为一个虚构名字，无实质论点，可能是一篇创意写作或测试文章。
paragraphs: 本文只有标题「Gloomberb」，无正文内容，无法提取具体论点或证据。
根据评分规则，此类纯标题或无可读内容的条目，信息量极低，评分处于低位。

en.thesis: The entry is a title-only piece with no substantial content.
paragraphs: This entry consists solely of the title 'Gloomberb' with no accompanying text, leaving no actual claims or evidence to discuss. It appears to be either a creative writing exercise or a placeholder.
Given the scoring rules, entries that are purely titles or contain no readable content are ranked low because they provide minimal information.

zh.thesis: 美国存在一个值得关注的社会事实，但文章未给出具体内容。
paragraphs: 这篇博客文章标题为「USA fact of the day」，但正文仅含链接和评论，无实质内容。
读者无从得知该事实为何，只能访问源链接获取信息。文章本身缺乏论证和细节。

en.thesis: The US is marked by a social fact worth noting, but the article offers no specifics.
paragraphs: The blog post titled 'USA fact of the day' contains only a link and a comment, with no substantive content.
Readers are left in the dark as to what the fact is, and must follow the source link to learn anything. The article itself lacks argument and detail.

articles.title: Codex in ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is now in preview
articles.author: allanrbo

zh.thesis: ChatGPT桌面应用Linux版预览发布，但无实质分析。
paragraphs: OpenAI宣布ChatGPT桌面应用Linux版进入预览，支持ChatGPT、Work和Codex，可在Linux系统上集成项目和浏览器工作流。
这仅是产品发布公告，无技术细节或对开发者的影响分析，故评分较低。

en.thesis: OpenAI's announcement of the Linux version of its ChatGPT desktop app entering preview is essentially a product launch note, offering little analytical substance.
paragraphs: OpenAI has announced that the Linux version of its ChatGPT desktop app is now in preview. The app supports ChatGPT, Work, and Codex, and allows users on Linux to integrate project and browser workflows directly into the desktop environment.

However, this is purely a product release announcement. It provides no technical details, nor does it analyze the implications for developers or users. As a result, the significance of this news is limited, yielding a low assessment.

zh.thesis: 这是一篇链接汇总，无核心论点，信息量大但缺乏深度分析。
paragraphs: 文章仅罗列五个话题链接，包括用AI六天写论文、医疗未来、可推广性研究、中国监管AI伴侣及手机与冲突关系，但均未展开。
作为聚合内容，适合快速了解动态，但无实质论证，价值有限。

en.thesis: This is a link roundup with no central argument, offering a broad but shallow overview of current topics.
paragraphs: The article merely lists five links covering topics like writing a thesis with AI in six days, the future of healthcare, the generalizability of research, China's regulation of AI companions, and the relationship between mobile phones and conflict, but none are explored in depth.
As aggregated content, it serves well for quickly catching up on developments, yet it lacks substantive analysis, making its value limited.

zh.thesis: 在科技行业，坚持己见而非随大流，才是真正的护城河。
paragraphs: 文章批评科技圈千篇一律的套路，主张以个人信念为职业杠杆。但内容多为付费预告，缺乏实质论证。
以星巴克为例提及，却未展开细节。整体更像播客导语，论点稀薄，证据缺失。

en.thesis: In the tech industry, holding firm to your own convictions rather than following the crowd is the real competitive advantage.
paragraphs: The article criticizes the tech world's tendency toward homogenized thinking, arguing that personal conviction is the ultimate career lever. However, the piece reads more like a teaser for a paid subscription, with arguments left thin and evidence sparse.

Starbucks is brought up as an example, but the details are never fleshed out. The overall effect is closer to a podcast intro than a substantive thesis, leaving the reader wanting more substance and proof.
